mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals increased demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the past month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, the combination signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO MoM decrease > 0.5%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO MoM decrease > 0.5%.
